body:
# Basic info
CrazyCraft is a self-hosted server that aims to put creativity first. X-ray is allowed, and a villager at spawn sells fireworks and mending, so you can spend more time crafting and less time mining. 
We have a friendly community, and our admins are always watching out for players.

Supports Java and Bedrock through Geyser.

# Claims
This server supports claims!
To create your first claim, type **/claim**.
To expand your claim, type **/claim addchunk (claim name, which is claim-0 by default)**
To fly in your claim, type **/claim fly**

# Bob
There is a villager at spawn named Bob 4 (don't ask about bobs 1-3) who sells:
1. Unbreaking III + Mending book for 4 diamonds
2. 64 fireworks for 1 raw iron block (raw iron so you can't use an iron farm)
